MF2_1.idea: one push to the edge, two switches: the crate must be pushed out of a column by a block that can only leave once switch A reverses it - and the push itself closes switch B's own lane; fire A early, or B late, and a block is boxed in for good

MG3_1.idea: a pull can lock two blocks face to face: each magnet drags a block into a lane where it meets a block pointing back at it - each magnet must wait until that block has left, and must still go before the block it is holding up
MG3_1.family: D magnet displacement (two magnets, face-to-face pulls)

MX4_1.idea: two ways to lock blocks face to face: the magnet drags a block under one pointing back at it, the switch turns a block toward one waiting for it - each must wait for the right block to leave, and both are needed
MX4_1.family: C/D magnet + switch (pull and flip deadlocks)
